visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of an ancient, primitive turtle that cannot retract its head or tail.
visual_logic.environment: Deep twilight reflecting off a muddy riverbank.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE to highlight the unique 'spiky' defenses.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: The head silhouette should show a blunt snout and, critically, prominent spikes or 'tubercular' scales along the neck.

pose: Side profile showing the heavily armored, club-like tail (complete with spikes) and the clear definition of the elephantine, clawed feet rather than flippers.
negative_constraints: No internal shading; the spikes on the neck and tail must be sharp and clearly visible in the outline.
